action.description: create writes a score and requires name/value/traceId even when action is omitted; list reads one Scores API v3 response page.

name.description: Required for create: score metric name. Ignored by list (not a name filter).

value.description: Required for create: score value forwarded unchanged; acceptable shape/type depends on the Langfuse API. Ignored by list.

traceId.description: Required for create: target trace ID. Ignored by list (not a trace filter).

observationId.description: Optional create-only observation ID within the target trace; omitted when absent.

comment.description: Optional create-only score comment, persisted remotely. Do not include secrets.

userId.description: Optional list-only user filter; ignored by create. Sent directly in the query string without URL encoding; use a query-safe value.

limit.description: List-only page size, clamped to 1..100 by execution. If omitted, no limit is sent (server default); does not auto-paginate.

page.description: List-only page number, floored at 1 by execution. If omitted, no page is sent (server default).
